runtime: Android renders canonical Manila building geometry from the existing offline city dataset. At runtime it reads building-footprints.geojson and building-details.geojson directly, matches way IDs, and fills only missing building tags; it does not rebuild or generate Manila shards. Generated facade-window GeoJSON remains disabled in the Android runtime.

photo_facade_textures.status: No human-verified building/photo matches are currently available; no candidate photo may be assigned automatically.

building_source.runtime_role: canonical building geometry and primary properties; supplemental GeoJSON files fill missing tags at runtime without changing geometry

street_source.runtime_role: always imported for named street-label geometry; labels overlay PBF road surfaces without replacing them

windows.note: Archived generated GeoJSON; not loaded, rendered, or required for APK builds

scene_overrides.source: manual scene-wide annotations from the first three saved Panoramax photographs
scope: windows doors entrances gates arches columns shopfronts signs
scene_overrides.spatial_projection: image-space polygons require calibrated geographic projection before rendering
